definition-changed.flag: class | of a data item; interface | of an object
definition-changed.answer: The rule's 'class' is the object-orientation class (§2002:4: 'The entity that defines common behavior and implementation for zero, one, or more objects'), not the class of a data item, so that definition does not apply. Interface of an object (§2002:4) differs from 2023 only in 'may' against 'can'. Neither changes what the rule governs.

cross-reference.answer: I read §2002:9.3.11. A word diff with §2023:9.3.11 is empty apart from the heading level ('The implementing class shall implement all the method specifications'), so the scope is unchanged.
